description: Catalog of intelligence layers. Each profile (profiles/<slug>.json) is an envelope (schema/competitor.schema.json) whose `layers` map is populated one layer at a time by the skill that owns it. To add a new intelligence domain: (1) flip its entry here from 'planned' to 'active' (or add one), (2) drop schema/layers/<id>.schema.json defining its domain fields (copy _template.schema.json), (3) build/point a skill at it. The envelope never changes; existing profiles stay valid.

layers.title: Shopify App Store intelligence
layers.summary: Everything observable on the public App Store listing + review pages: name/subtitle strategy, badges, pricing tiers & model, reviews (rating/count/velocity/complaint themes), positioning, keyword-search visibility, capability matrix vs the baseline app, screenshot merchandising.

layers.title: Pricing intelligence
layers.summary: Longitudinal pricing & packaging: archived fee timelines, silent increases, effective take-rate, discounting. (Snapshot App Store pricing lives in app_store.)

layers.title: Messaging & positioning intelligence
layers.summary: Homepage/landing narrative, value-prop language, competitive claims, proof and objection-handling patterns.

layers.title: Ad creative intelligence
layers.summary: Observable paid creative from public ad libraries: active ads, angles, hooks, run duration.

layers.title: SEO & content intelligence
layers.summary: Organic footprint: comparison pages, content moats, ranking keywords.

layers.title: Customer sentiment intelligence
layers.summary: Voice-of-customer beyond the App Store: review sites and forums, churn triggers, switching narratives.

layers.title: Technical stack detection
layers.summary: Detected site stack, analytics & martech tags, infrastructure signals.

layers.title: AI / LLM visibility
layers.summary: How the app surfaces in LLM answers and AI-driven discovery.
